name: Death end re;Quest
source:
Death end re;Quest takes the classic turn-based RPG and flips it upside-down. Switch between the RPG action of the game world and the visual novel segments of the real world. In the realm of game development, it may seem all fun and games until the lines between fantasy and reality begin to blur.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/990050/Death_end_reQuest/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《Death end re;Quest》将经典的回合制角色扮演游戏进行了颠覆。在游戏世界的角色扮演动作和现实世界的视觉小说片段之间切换。在游戏开发领域，一切看起来都很有趣和游戏，直到幻想与现实之间的界限开始变得模糊。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/990050/Death_end_reQuest/]Steam[/url]]
